messages.subject: install.libs.R and system.file
parts: I am developing a package which builds a command line executable in src/ and then installs it to bin/ with install.libs.R. When not using devtools, the executable is installed to $SITE_LIBRARY/pkg_name/bin/exe_name and found with system.file('bin', exe_name, package=pkg_name). However, things break when devtools inserts the shim for system.file because when the package is built the executable isn't installed to local inst/bin. What's the recommended way to handle this? Currently I've had to turn off the "Use devtools package functions if available" to build and test my package.
